title: [ExpenseAgent] Refactor agent setup for policies
summary: Expense Agent administrators can now disallow users from running policy checks, adding a configuration option to the Expense Agent setup wizard and pages.
key_points: Added ability for admins to control whether users can run policy checks
Modified Expense Agent Setup table to support the new configuration option
Updated setup wizard and API pages to reflect the new policy control settings
Refactored agent setup flow to include policy restriction management
quote: Expense Agent admins should be able to disallow user-run policy check
